name: amp-for-bandcamp
description: Amplifies Bandcamp functionality with playback controls and UI improvements
author: Rafał Enden

scripts.build: wxt build && wxt build -b firefox && wxt build -b safari
scripts.build:safari: npm run build:safari:web && xcodebuild -project 'safari/Amp for Bandcamp.xcodeproj' -scheme 'Amp for Bandcamp (macOS)' -configuration Release -derivedDataPath dist/safari clean build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:zip && npm run build:safari
scripts.ci: npm run compile && npm run test:local
scripts.test:local: npm test -- tests/Popup.spec.ts tests/Content.spec.ts tests/Bpm.spec.ts tests/AlbumControls.spec.ts tests/Background.spec.ts tests/CollectionControls.spec.ts tests/DiscoverControls.spec.ts tests/DiscoverAudioHook.spec.ts tests/HomeControls.spec.ts tests/FeedPage.spec.ts tests/LivePage.spec.ts tests/Mute.spec.ts tests/Settings.spec.ts tests/Shortcuts.spec.ts tests/Security.spec.ts tests/Performance.spec.ts
scripts.test:live: npm test -- tests/AlbumPage.spec.ts tests/CollectionPage.spec.ts tests/DiscoverPage.spec.ts tests/HomePage.spec.ts
